Strategy: When the sum of all feasible residuals is even the rule is Best Fit, but when it is odd the rule takes the emptiest bin, so the parity of the total residual flips the preferred bin. It differs from Best Fit only on odd totals. It may help if odd totals correlate with fragmented states worth spreading, or fail because parity is arbitrary and may flip choices for no packing reason.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    s = sum(bins)
    return [(-(r - item) if s % 2 == 0 else r) for r in bins]
```
